captions.k1: Hello! I'm Klacksy, your electronic colleague at Klacks.
captions.k2: One sentence from you instead of many clicks – more time for other things.
captions.k3: Rules and processes live in Klacks – not just in individual planners' heads.
captions.k4: You leave me the grunt work, and you keep the decision.
captions.x1: I'd love to work with you. Just give me a try!
